scripts.build: pnpm build:rust && pnpm --filter enginebox-dashboard build && pnpm --filter enginebox-site build
scripts.check: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked && pnpm --filter enginebox-dashboard typecheck && pnpm --filter enginebox-site check
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast --locked && pnpm --filter enginebox-dashboard test && pnpm --filter enginebox-site test && pnpm --filter @enginebox/deploy test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter enginebox-dashboard test:e2e && pnpm --filter enginebox-site test:e2e
